description:
Find published CliniAtlas evidence answers matching a clinical question.

        Call this first for a clinical question: it is instant and does not use the user's
        free daily answers. Returns question, summary and link for each match. The library
        is a set of worked answers to common questions; when one matches, use
        get_evidence_answer for the full answer. locale (for example de, fr, hr) returns
        translated answers where they exist.
name: search_evidence_library
title: Search the CliniAtlas evidence library
